arguments.name: hashKey
arguments.description: (Required) Hash key to use for lookups and identification of the item

arguments.name: item
arguments.description: (Required) JSON representation of a map of attribute name/value pairs, one for each attribute. Only the primary key attributes are required; you can optionally provide other attribute name-value pairs for the item.

arguments.name: rangeKey
arguments.description: (Optional) Range key to use for lookups and identification of the item. Required if there is range key defined in the table.

arguments.name: tableName
arguments.description: (Required) Name of the table to contain the item.
